book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 Korin Pol pepa asamoll bolo dumo Korin una awi

content: Juda una gollne singare ke yei mal nono ye djimbon

Agana ambana kambono, ye pille kune yene dje na kandja djindo. Iwa Mosis moi poke ge, nono gollne kambono molmaka, God kam kupa ta dje worika, wo no gollne kondwe pine mal ombine dje awi. Awika ga po molo nu retsi to pruk dje er konato orko pi (Kisim Bek 14).
Retsi pi ge ne, kam kupa kani al ge, ga nu pai mal embe yei. Alla nu pai al ge, ga Mosis epilye moi.
Ga porapora kwa noi ge God Murble awika noi.
Alla nu noi ge God Murble awi ku al woika ga noi. Kaima, nu woi al ku ge, ga boll aike wani. Alla, ku ge yene Krais moi.
Embe pai ba, merke singare ke yemaka, God ke pille toika, dumo wapra yei al ga golo ne to moi.
Nono gollne wal noip dje, imbon dje pille pla yei mal ge, wal su mal embe yewori paro. Nono embe nayembon.
Kambono god kende boll lotu ye awi mal, ye embe nayene! Baibel kandja embe bolo wori paro,

content.text: Kambono ami dje molo kwa no nu no kere, are aglo po god kende pille pla ye awo singare ke yei we dji (Kisim Bek 32.6)

content: Kambono djingdjang ke embe yei mal ge, nono nayembon. God toika, ga 23,000 goi.
Ga God nono tonda mo natonda ne dje singare yei mal embe nayembon. Are nomaga ke wo tomaka, pende goi.
Alla pende God boll tawa djimaka tau agelo tondo una ge wo ga togoi. Embe yei pille nono embe nayembon.
Makimb pora djino dje yenda poke nono mormon pille, nono gollne kambono yei mal embe nono kanpol to mopon dje une Baibel al bolo wori paro.
Embe yei pille, na aglo gi djino dje una ta embe pi dal, une kanpol tonda. Une yage djino dje pille kanpol tonda.

Satan ye kamalne tondo ge une ye taimane mor mal pille kamalne natondo. Una porapora kamalne tondo mal une ye boll kamalne tondo. Tonda ba God kandja dji mal kaima yenda. Ye kapak to yago djine dje pille man djinda. Une ye kond to aundaka ye aglo gi dje moye, kulngamb nayagne.
Nono Godne ne, god kende aike lotu ye naumbon
Unakna wopake kambono, God embe yenda pille, una god kende lotu ye awinj mal ge, kere seke pine.
Ye nomane paro. Na kandja djindo ge, ye omuk to piye kune yenda.
Nono kap wain no, God wopake we dje aunmon kap nonmon ge, Krais meyamiye nono i taimane nawordo mo? Nono bret tuklo nonmon ge, Krais gakle nono i taimane nawordo mo?
Nono bret nonmon ge, bret taimane ge nonmon. Nonmon al ge, nono gaklene taimane mal embe paro.
Juda una singare ye waninj ge ye kaninj. Ga alta al wal togolo gale opa ye awinj ge, mindjiye pende i nonj al ge, ga i taimane wordo.
Ga god kende bekinj ge wal kaima yero we djino mo? Mo, opa gale iwo god kende awinj ge singare pai mal yenj we djino mo?

Ge man! Na kandja embe djindo, orko una po alta al wal opa ye awinj ge, God pille opa ye nawinj, ga kum ke pille opa ye awinj we djindo. Alla kambono kum ke lotu ye awinj mal ge, ye po embe ye djine dje na nomana embe paro.
Ye Iwa Kerman ne, kum ke boll aike kap wain taimane nane ge kune nayenda. Ye Iwa Kerman ne, kum ke boll aike bo al kwa taimane nane ge kune nayenda.
God nono elle kumbso aunda dje nayembon. Nono yembene paro ge, yemolo God yembe paro mal kamblo aunda mo?
God nale al wal mindjiye nambon wambo naparo

Wal porapora yembon ge wambo naparo, yembon we djinj ba, wal pende nono ye wopake ye naunda. Wal porapora yembon ge wambo naparo, yembon we djinj ba, wal pende yewordaka nono Krais boll aglo gi nadjimbon.
Nono singare yembon ge, nonekene wopake mopon dje nayembon, man. Nono una djell ta wopake moye dje yembon.
Wal mindjiye iwo maket ta pagiye ge, ye nane wambo naparo. Ye nomane to, mindjiye nambon wambo paro mo man da? dje ye napiye.
Nono kanmon,

content.text: Dumo makimb yero ge ne, wal porapora pakna paro ge, Iwa Kerman wal ne moro we dji (Buk Song 24.1)

content: Alla, Jisas boll pillgi nadinj una kwa aike nambon we djineke, ye kambono numbine al bon dje piye ge, ye pine kune yenda. Kwa gale aune mal ye kiwa nane, ye nambon kune yendo mo man ne? dje ye nomane to napiye.

Ba alla, una ta ye moye al kandja embe djinda, mindjiye nonmon ge, una ipo god kende moi al opa ye awi mindjiye we dji dal, ye nanane. Una nalene al ne, iwa ge nale al, ye wambo pa djinda dje pille, nanane.

Na kandja embe djindo ge, ye nane wambo panda dje pille na nadjindo, man. Na djindo ge, ye naneke, iwa ge nale al ye wambo pa djinda dje pille, na kandja ge djindo. Na wal nano ba iwa ge mapill paro we djindo ge namba yei pille na kantau yenda?
Na God pille wopake we dje awo kere kwa nano. Una kane, ni kwa nonden ge, wambo paro we djine ge kune nayenda.
Embe yenda pille, ye kwamokna nane mo, ye nu ta nane mo, ye singare ta yene ge, ye God kandjiye kerman panda dje yene.
Ye singare ta yene ge, ye Juda una ne, epil djell una ne, pillgi djinj una porapora pille, ga kanke ye djine dje pille singare embe yene.

Ye singare embe yene we dje na kandja embe djindo ge, na embe ye una porapora kanwopake piye dje yendo. Nanam wopake moyo dje nayendo, una porapora wopake moye dje yendo. Embe yendo ge, God kambono i yem worda dje na embe yendo.
